name: Sub-5yoe candidate deflects on CGPA / college probe
notes: v5.2 realism: pedigree_evasion — Indian HR routinely probes academics under 5 YOE; 'don't remember exactly' reads as hiding a weak GPA.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Backend engineer, 3 years at a Bangalore product company on the payments team.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Which college did you graduate from, and what was your CGPA?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It was a long time ago, I don't remember the exact CGPA. Why does it matter at this point?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off and a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Redesigned the refund pipeline to handle async webhooks at 2M events/day; cut p99 from 1.2s to 200ms over four months.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your engineering blog on idempotency keys and the scale of catalog you're at line up with what I want to work on next.
